opt.head.desc: Manage the AI connection, save range, and per-page memory rules.
opt.ai.keyHint: The API key is stored only in chrome.storage.local; it is sent externally only when requesting the selected AI API.
opt.memory.hint: When injectHtml / injectCss / injectScript and similar succeed in the sidebar chat, they are auto-saved as a revisit rule for the range selected here. Individual rules can be changed later in the list below.
opt.workflow.allowIrreversible: Auto-click buttons that look like purchase/confirm/delete
opt.workflow.allowIrreversibleHint: When off, auto-run holds clicks that look like final confirmation. When on, recorded steps are trusted and clicked as-is.
opt.daemon.intro: When the daemon is enabled, memos (with text) left on the page are sent to the AI automatically without a screenshot. “Send image to AI” (drawings) are burned into a screenshot and sent. Start the daemon (cd daemon && npm start) and paste the token shown at startup below. When disabled or unreachable, it falls back to chrome.downloads as before.
opt.daemon.enable: Send to the daemon (enable WebSocket push)
opt.daemon.tokenPlaceholder: token shown when the daemon starts
opt.daemon.hint: The token authenticates the local WebSocket (prevents localhost connections from malicious web pages / mitigates CVE-2025-52882). It is stored only in chrome.storage.local.
opt.daemon.autoSyncHint: Sending happens only when the daemon is reachable; it does not auto-download on failure. Memo-only changes (no drawings) are sent as text without a screenshot.
opt.daemon.saveDirHint: The save folder applies only when the daemon is enabled. Empty saves to the OS default Downloads folder (only paths under your home directory are adopted; for paths outside home, use --inbox on the daemon).
opt.daemon.timeout: Timed out (daemon not running or wrong URL)
opt.daemon.testFailed: Connection failed (not running / wrong URL / token mismatch)
opt.eg2.intro: Using local eg2-cli (EmbeddingGemma 2), elements like buttons and links are identified and clicked in tens of milliseconds from natural language instructions (System 1 Fast Path). Saves external LLM tokens and latency.
opt.eg2.hint: Requires eg2 server running on http://127.0.0.1:38765. Only loopback addresses (127.0.0.1 / localhost) are allowed for security.
opt.eg2.testFailed: Connection failed (not running or invalid URL: {error})
opt.rules.hint: Saving a note or making changes to a page via chat automatically adds a rule for that URL. Use manual add when you want to apply to a broader range, such as a whole domain.
opt.rules.empty: No remembered URLs yet. They are added automatically when you add a note or make changes via chat.
opt.recipe.hint: A JSON array of verb actions applied every time the selected URL/rule page loads. Display changes added via chat are also saved here.
opt.recipe.errShape: Each item must be in {verb, args} form.
opt.recipe.errVerb: Only these verbs are allowed in recipes: {verbs} (got: {verb})

actions.workflowTitle: Record the notes you leave across pages as an ordered, URL-by-URL workflow

workflow.hint: Recording on: your clicks, typing and selections on the page become steps (notes too). Runs replay them deterministically, one step at a time.

workflow.loadedMsg: Loaded workflow into current steps. Ask the AI to run it.
workflow.autorunTitle: Run the recorded steps automatically, navigating across pages in URL order. Final confirm/purchase buttons are auto-clicked only when allowed in Options.
workflow.autorunConfirm: Start auto-run? Recorded steps run one at a time on this tab. AI is only used for steps that choose by condition or when a target cannot be found. Steps marked “needs approval” stop for you.
workflow.autorunStartBanner: Auto-run started — watch the chat for each step.
cs.err.autorunHeld: Held: this looks like a final confirm/purchase button, so auto-run did not click it. Please do it manually.

sw.autorun.mismatch: Auto-run stopped: could not reach a page matching the next step ({url}).
sw.autorun.failed: Auto-run stopped: couldn't complete this page's step (no action ran). Do it manually, then restart.
